verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a government registry service, so the axis applies. However, every documented action (incorporation, annual returns, director and office changes, certificates) is offered only through the human-facing Online Filing Centre or the PDF/email/mail channel. The only API observed is the national open.canada.ca CKAN open-data layer, and the probe notes that the registry itself documents no transactional API on any surface checked.
